meta.description: Default Noble Architecture interior door handle. Unified asset file containing merged 2D plan, 2D elevation, and 3D mesh export data for door mode.
meta.namingConvention: All custom keys prefixed Na__. Three-stage form Na__Section__SubSection__FieldName. Geometry primitives in Paths arrays use PathType (Line | Arc | Circle | Polygon).

fieldPrefixes.Na__Asset__: Top-level asset metadata and content blocks
fieldPrefixes.Na__PanelPlacement__: Door-panel mounting transforms (RH/LH handing, vertical datum)

Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: Unified default interior door handle assembled from exported 2D plan/elevation source data and the existing production 3D mesh contract.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: Plan2D, Elevation2D merged from exporter output. Mesh3D re-exported 03-May-2026 with per-vertex normals (Normal_X/Y/Z) and real Sketchup::Edge flags (IsSoft/IsSmooth/IsHidden/CastsShadows). Asset authored lying on back; consumer applies Z -90 then X -90 rotation around 00__OriginPoint when inserting.

Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of 00__OriginPoint group (handle spindle). Right-hand orientation.
Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=right, Y=forward (away from door face) | Units=mm | Z discarded

Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = centre of 00__OriginPoint group (handle spindle). Front view of asset.
Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=right, Y=up | Units=mm | Z discarded

Na__Asset__ObjectHierarchy3D.Na__Hierarchy__OriginNote: Hierarchy captured from 03__Model3D with nested groups/components preserved.
